summary: Add inactive authenticated jobs submit, show and list routes. Every response states admission not wired; submissions record queued history only.

replay.detail: Uses existing job.recorded projection and public append API. An absent-subject CAS serializes concurrent submissions; retries resolve the durable requester/key receipt.

schema.detail: Add requester/canonical-order jobs index. POST /v1/client/jobs accepts key, execution_host and canonical request; GET /v1/client/jobs/{job/id} shows caller-owned history; GET /v1/client/jobs lists caller history or host queue with ?host=NAME, always requester-isolated. List order is canonical submission order.

rules.detail: Authenticated session.actor supplies requester; request JSON cannot override it. Configured classes and background/normal priorities declare intent only: no admission, elevation, preemption, launch or execution grant. No admission hooks are enabled.

compatibility.detail: HTTP 503 jobs-disabled or jobs-projection-stale; 409 idempotency-digest-mismatch, conflicting-host, stale-authority or origin-mismatch; 422 invalid-request, job-class-not-allowed, job-priority-unknown or unknown-host; 403 forbidden; 404 not-found. Existing authentication/scope errors remain unchanged. Success is HTTP 200 with admission='not wired'. No client/schema generator derives routes from this hand-written API.

downtime.detail: Disabled by default. Missing jobs config, enabled=false or an empty allowed_classes list disables all jobs routes.

manual.detail: Explicit jobs.enabled=true and jobs.allowed_classes=['heavy'] enables recording only. Configuration is injected into Unix, Fabric and browser routers as an Extension, not stored as execution authority. Limit, timeout and concurrency defaults are not added.

recovery.detail: Ambiguous submissions reuse requester/key/digest. Receipts never launch work, and no runtime or host activation is introduced.
